Play Montage Events - There's quite a bit of duplicated work happening here, but it is because Mover and CMC based characters have two different play montage calls. This iimportant to note, because they apply montages slightly different under the hood. The rest of the work here is for handling looping, which is not an inherent function, and because we rely on asynchronus functions. At the end, Call Owner Montage Finished is what tells the state tree that we are able to move to the next state.
